name: Jellyfish
summary: A swarm of one jellyfish species in a deep tank: moon, sea nettle, crystal, atolla, comb jelly or lion's mane, each glowing the way it does in the sea, to the music.
hint: One species per layer; stack layers to mix them. They live on their own (swimming, drifting with the current, keeping apart) and the music only sways them: Natural barely, Reactive gently, Performance fully. Every bell lights as it squeezes and glows in the water round it. Each species also lights its own way: moon jellies breathe their gonads with the bass and sparkle their rhopalia on the hi-hats, sea nettles' stripes pulse with the mids, crystal jellies flash their green rims on onsets, an atolla spins its blue alarm pinwheel on a drop, comb jellies race rainbows along their combs with the hi-hats, a lion's mane sends waves of light down its hair with the sustained low end.

params.label: Colours
params.help: Natural: each species in its own colours. Palette: the layer's palette, drifting with the music. Palette light: natural bodies glowing in the palette's colours.

params.label: Music
params.help: How much the music steers them. They swim and glow on their own in silence.

params.label: Tentacles
params.help: How many of the species' tentacles to draw.

params.label: Bioluminescence
params.help: The species' own light: gonads, stripes, rim lights, pinwheel, comb rows, hair.

params.label: Glow in the water
params.help: Their light in the water round them, and on the plankton.

params.label: Translucency
params.help: The glassy bell: edges glow, faces stay clear.

params.label: Water
params.help: Deep water and light shafts behind them, for an aquarium look. Auto exposure lifts water that fills the frame, so keep it low (0: black, best for stacking layers).

params.label: View
params.help: Tank: the whole swarm. Close-up: the camera follows one jelly and slowly circles it.
